title: Company-level commitment cascade and cross-team operational agreements
creator: Priya Patel
description:
Problem statement: company-level OKRs in the last two quarters have produced inconsistent downstream initiatives — teams interpret objective language differently, leading to duplicate work, missed scope, and unclear ownership. This ticket creates a repeatable commitment cascade and a lightweight operational agreement template so company OKRs translate into measurable team commitments with clear RACI, risks, and rollback criteria.

Scope: define a 3-phase playbook (Pilot, Scale, Institutionalize) covering: 1) commitment cascade template mapping company objectives -> initiative outcomes -> team deliverables; 2) operational agreement artifact (roles, decision rights, escalation paths, measurement hooks); 3) tooling additions to the OKR dashboard (alignment score, stale-dependency alerts); 4) rollout plan and training materials for PM/Eng/Design leads.

Success measures: reduce reported cross-team OKR misalignment incidents by 80% within 2 quarters; 50% faster translation from company objective to team-level delivery plan (target from median 12 days to <=6 days in pilot); alignment score >= 0.8 in pilot teams.

Trade-offs and decisions: We considered a centralized gate (PM council sign-off) but chose a lightweight operational agreement to preserve team autonomy while adding explicit decision paths — this balances speed against risk of divergence. For tooling, we will initially augment the existing OKR dashboard with derived alignment metrics (non-blocking) rather than build a new system.

Artifacts: PRD and playbook draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/OKR-Cascade-2025; pilot checklist and slide deck: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/OKR-Cascade-Pilot; initial prototype PR to add alignment metrics: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4892.

Rollout plan:
 - Phase 1 (Pilot, 4 weeks): run with three cross-functional pods (Serving Runtime, Redwood Console, Dedicated Capacity). Each pod completes the operational agreement and submits to the PM alignment channel.
 - Phase 2 (Scale, 6 weeks): refine based on pilot feedback, add automation for stale-dependency alerts, and provide brown-bag training.
 - Phase 3 (Institutionalize): default template in OKR intake flow and quarterly retrospective gate.

Risks and mitigations:
 - Risk: teams feel overhead; Mitigation: keep operational agreement to 1 page and integrate with existing sprint rituals.
 - Risk: alignment metrics are noisy; Mitigation: build human-in-the-loop verification for first two cycles and clearly document metric heuristics.

Next steps (this ticket): finalize playbook, implement two dashboard queries (alignment score + stale dependency), schedule pilot kickoff with pod leads, collect baseline alignment metrics.
